meta.curve: held-out accuracy (all 1026 held-out statements) of probes fitted to n labelled training statements, half true and half false, 20 random draws per n; logistic regression C = 1; difference of means thresholded at the midpoint of its two class means
meta.trainer: layer 16; one nested draw (the first n of one random order alternating true and false); coords in an orthonormal basis containing every fitted direction, centred on the training mean, 3 d.p.
meta.pairs: each held-out city's h(true) - h(false), against the training difference of means
